ecms.name: LED Lighting Retrofit
ecms.description: Replace T8 fluorescent with LED throughout all 5 floors. LPD reduction from 10.8 to 7.0 W/m².
ecms.uncertainty_basis: Sensitivity: ±15% LPD → ±16.3% energy. Fixture wattage measured (high confidence), hours stipulated (moderate).

ecms.name: Chiller Replacement
ecms.description: Replace aging 15-year-old chiller with high-efficiency unit. COP improvement from 3.2 to 4.0.
ecms.uncertainty_basis: Sensitivity: ±15% COP → ±7.6% energy. COP from nameplate with degradation assumption (moderate confidence).

ecms.name: VAV Box Optimization
ecms.description: Optimize VAV box minimum flow setpoints and schedules. Equivalent to ~15% fan efficiency improvement.
ecms.uncertainty_basis: Sensitivity: ±15% fan efficiency → ±3.8% energy. Fan performance from design docs only (moderate confidence).

note: Savings estimated from calibrated simulation sensitivity analysis. Individual ECM savings may not sum linearly due to interactive effects.
